newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Senior NZ First official, candidate resigns.
newsitem.headline: Senior NZ First official, candidate resigns.

text.p: New Zealand First's Wellington regional chairman and Wellington Central candidate, lawyer David Stevenson, has resigned from all positions with the party, a party spokesperson said on Thursday.
Stevenson was ranked 24th on the party's list released on Monday and was irked at his placing, sources in New Zealand First said.
Stevenson was not immediately available to comment.
A spokesman for NZ First leader Winston Peters said the resignation did not say much for Stevenson's optimism about the party's chances.
NZ First is rating about 19 percent in opinion polls which would qualify it for 23 seats in parliament after the October 12 election.
Other senior members of the party are also disgruntled about their placing.

Former broadcasting spokesman Rex Widerstrom, who was placed 28th on the list, said he was still considering his position and trying to talk to figures in the party about his future. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746
